scope: F06-08: test transfer of supplied constant-acceleration dynamics to measured local motion; a failed gate is a valid result
sampling: anchor at first observed timestamp at or after each window start; nearest observation to anchor+offset; no interpolation; ties choose earlier
model_selection: no selection after evaluation; fit x0,v0,a on the first 10 samples for each axis/window, never on future values
synthetic_control: closed-form positions from each training fit at the same future times, only as numerical control
measurement_bound_interpretation: published setup-level empirical bound, not per-sample covariance or independent Gaussian noise
uncertainty_sensitivity: absolute-error budget 0.01*(1+sum(abs(OLS prediction weights))) for training and future measured positions; conditional bound only; time jitter and correlated systematic errors not fully known
hypothesis_failure: retain every rejected segment; if gate fails, constant-acceleration model is not promoted to measured-motion prediction; no new law is declared
larger_problem_policy: blocked until the measured-motion gate passes on independent sequences with known forcing or validated applicability
independence: one public previously available trajectory, 24 correlated axis/windows; not a blind heldout dataset, not new measurement, not F10 independent replication
data_exposure_before_registration: dataset downloaded during previous session; first raw lines inspected, no dynamics fitting or scoring performed before this registration
reporting: all 24 segments including sampling/domain failures; report pooled RMSE, per-axis/per-window errors, numerical controls and negative cases; no confidence interval treating correlated samples as independent
